help.pan.body: Your ten-character Permanent Account Number. This is filled from a valid GSTIN.
help.bankName.title: Bank name

help.accountNumber.title: Account number
help.accountNumber.body: Enter the full account number carefully. It is stored only on this computer.
help.ifsc.title: IFSC
help.ifsc.body: The 11-character branch code on your cheque book or bank statement.
help.upiId.title: UPI ID
help.upiId.body: Your payment address from your UPI app. QR printing will arrive with invoices.
help.logo.title: Business logo
help.logo.body: Choose a PNG or JPEG up to 5 MB. We copy it into local app storage.
help.signature.title: Signature image

module.home: Your business overview and next steps.
module.parties: Manage customers, suppliers and their balances.
module.items: Manage products, services, prices and stock.
module.invoices: Create GST invoices, receive payments and print bills.
module.estimates: Send quotations and convert accepted estimates into invoices.
module.proforma: Prepare a preliminary bill before the final invoice.
module.paymentIn: Record customer receipts and link them to invoices.
module.saleOrders: Track customer orders and delivery due dates.
module.challans: Record goods sent before an invoice is issued.
module.saleReturns: Create credit notes for returned goods.
module.pos: Bill quickly at the counter using barcodes and shortcuts.
module.bills: Record supplier bills and input tax.
module.paymentOut: Record payments to suppliers and allocate them to bills.
module.expenses: Keep daily business costs organised by category.
module.purchaseOrders: Plan purchases and convert orders into bills.
module.purchaseReturns: Record goods returned to suppliers with debit notes.
module.bankAccounts: Manage bank accounts, UPI and transfers.
module.cashHand: Follow cash receipts, payments and adjustments.
module.cheques: Track received, issued and post-dated cheques.
module.loans: Keep track of loans, instalments and interest.
module.reports: Understand sales, stock, party balances and GST.
module.backup: Keep a local copy of your business and restore it when needed.
module.utilities: Import, export and maintain your business records.

masters.conversion: Base units in one secondary unit
masters.image: Item image (PNG / JPEG, up to 2 MB)
masters.adjustHelp: Choose a unit and its price. Quantity and value are recorded in the stock ledger. Reductions cannot exceed stock when negative-stock protection is on.
masters.lookupHelp: Rename entries here. Only unused entries can be deleted. Standard units stay available for everyone.
masters.deleteUnused: Delete {{name}}? This is permanent and only allowed when no records use it.
masters.conversionHelp: Example: 1 Box = 12 Pcs. A conversion can be selected when adding an item.
masters.deleteConversion: Delete this conversion? Existing items keep their saved conversion.

masters.importBody: Choose a local Excel or CSV file, match columns and review rows before importing.
masters.importRules: Up to 10,000 rows / 10 MB. Prices are in rupees; dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Use existing category names and unit symbols. Tax rate is a percentage. Templates include column headers; fill your rows below. Duplicate item codes are rejected. Imports add new records.

masters.error.name: Enter a name.
help.master-name.title: Name
help.master-name.body: Enter the person, business, product or service name you will recognise when billing.
help.master-phone.title: Phone number
help.master-phone.body: Use a 10-digit Indian mobile number without +91. Leave it blank if unavailable.
help.master-email.title: Email
help.master-email.body: Optional email address for this party. Entering an address does not send any messages.
help.master-gstType.title: GST registration type
help.master-gstType.body: Choose Consumer for an unregistered party, Regular for normal GST registration, or Composition for the composition scheme.
help.master-gstin.title: GSTIN
help.master-gstin.body: Enter the 15-character GST number. The checksum is checked and its state is filled automatically.
help.master-stateCode.title: State
help.master-stateCode.body: Choose the state of registration or residence. A valid GSTIN fills this automatically. It helps decide local or interstate GST during billing.
help.master-billingAddress.title: Billing address
help.master-billingAddress.body: The address that should appear on this party’s bills. Include locality, city and PIN code.
help.master-shippingAddress.title: Shipping address
help.master-shippingAddress.body: Where goods are delivered. Keep Same as billing selected if both addresses match.
help.master-openingBalance.title: Opening balance (₹)
help.master-openingBalance.body: The amount already owed before you start BillSathi. To Receive means they owe you; To Pay means you owe them.
help.master-balanceDirection.title: Balance direction
help.master-balanceDirection.body: Choose To Receive when the party owes you money, or To Pay when you owe the party.
help.master-balanceDirection.example: To Receive: the customer owes you
help.master-openingDate.title: As-of date
help.master-openingDate.body: The date of your opening balance or stock count. Earlier entries still contribute to a date-filtered running balance.
help.master-creditLimitMode.title: Credit limit
help.master-creditLimitMode.body: Choose None for unlimited credit or Custom limit to set the maximum unpaid amount.
help.master-creditLimit.title: Credit limit (₹)
help.master-creditLimit.body: The maximum unpaid amount allowed for this party. Sales will use it to warn before exceeding credit. Zero means no credit.
help.master-groupId.title: Party group
help.master-groupId.body: Group similar customers or suppliers. Create a group beside this field or in Settings → Party.
help.master-newGroup.title: New group name
help.master-newGroup.body: Create a reusable party group, then it is selected for this party.
help.master-active.title: Active
help.master-active.body: Active parties are available for new transactions. Inactive parties keep their history for reference.
help.master-active.example: Turn off for a party you no longer deal with
help.master-type.title: Type
help.master-type.body: Products have physical stock. Services are work you bill for and do not keep stock quantities.
help.master-date.title: Date
help.master-date.body: Date when the stock count or adjustment happened. Use the actual business date.
help.master-code.title: Item code
help.master-code.body: An optional unique code for this item within the business. Assign Code finds the next unused BillSathi code.
help.master-hsn.title: HSN / SAC
help.master-hsn.body: HSN classifies goods; SAC classifies services. Enter 4–8 digits and check the code and applicable rate before billing.
help.master-categoryId.title: Category
help.master-categoryId.body: Organise items into categories to make searching and filtering easier. Create a category beside this field.
help.master-newCategory.title: New category name
help.master-newCategory.body: Creates a category and selects it for this item. You can rename it from the Categories tab.
help.master-unitId.title: Base unit
help.master-unitId.body: The main unit used for stock quantities and opening price. Secondary units are converted into this unit.
help.master-secondaryUnitId.title: Secondary unit
help.master-secondaryUnitId.body: An optional larger or smaller unit. Set how many base units one secondary unit contains.
help.master-conversion.title: Base units in one secondary unit
help.master-conversion.body: Number of base units in one secondary unit. Every stock movement is saved in base units, with up to three decimals.
help.master-image.title: Item image (PNG / JPEG, up to 2 MB)
help.master-image.body: Choose a local PNG or JPEG image up to 2 MB. The image stays in your local database.
help.master-salePrice.title: Sale price (₹)
help.master-salePrice.body: The price charged for one base unit, in rupees. Choose whether GST is already included using the tax mode.
help.master-saleTaxMode.title: Sale price tax mode
help.master-saleTaxMode.body: With tax means GST is already part of the sale price. Without tax means GST is added when billing.
help.master-purchaseTaxMode.title: Purchase price tax mode
help.master-purchaseTaxMode.body: Choose whether your purchase price already includes GST. This is saved separately from the sale price tax mode.
help.master-discountType.title: Sale discount type
help.master-discountType.body: Choose Percentage for a proportion of the sale price, or Amount for a fixed rupee discount per unit.
help.master-discountAmount.title: Sale discount (₹)
help.master-discountAmount.body: A fixed discount in rupees on the sale price of each base unit.
help.master-discountBps.title: Sale discount (%)
help.master-discountBps.body: Sale discount percentage from 0 to 100, with up to two decimal places.
help.master-wholesalePrice.title: Wholesale price (₹)
help.master-wholesalePrice.body: The price for bulk orders. Minimum wholesale quantity sets when this price can apply.
help.master-wholesaleQty.title: Minimum wholesale quantity
help.master-wholesaleQty.body: The smallest quantity eligible for the wholesale price, measured in the base unit.
help.master-purchasePrice.title: Purchase price (₹)
help.master-purchasePrice.body: Your cost for one base unit in rupees. Opening stock uses its own recorded opening price.
help.master-mrp.title: MRP (₹)
help.master-mrp.body: Maximum retail price printed on the product. Enter the amount in rupees.
help.master-taxRateId.title: Tax rate
help.master-taxRateId.body: Choose a GST, IGST or exempt rate from the tax list. Confirm the rate applicable to this item before billing.
help.master-openingQty.title: Opening stock quantity
help.master-openingQty.body: The quantity already on hand on the as-of date, measured in the base unit. This creates an opening stock ledger entry.
help.master-openingPrice.title: Opening price per base unit (₹)
help.master-openingPrice.body: Cost of one base unit for opening stock, in rupees. Quantity × this price gives opening stock value.
help.master-minStock.title: Minimum stock
help.master-minStock.body: Marked low stock when quantity is at or below this number, measured in base units.
help.master-location.title: Location / rack
help.master-location.body: Optional shelf, rack or storage location to help find the item.
help.master-qty.title: Quantity
help.master-qty.body: Positive quantity in the selected unit, with at most three decimal places. Secondary units convert to the base unit.
help.master-price.title: Price per selected unit (₹)
help.master-price.body: Cost of one selected unit in rupees. For a box adjustment, enter the price of the whole box.
help.master-direction.title: Stock adjustment
help.master-direction.body: Add increases stock; Reduce decreases it. Record a reason so you can understand the change later.
help.master-reason.title: Reason
help.master-reason.body: A short explanation of why stock changed, such as damage, found stock or a counting correction.
help.master-symbol.title: Unit symbol
help.master-symbol.body: A short unique unit label used in item forms and spreadsheet imports.
help.master-fromUnit.title: Secondary unit (from)
help.master-fromUnit.body: The secondary unit on the left side of the conversion. One of these equals the entered number of base units.
help.master-toUnit.title: Base unit (to)
help.master-toUnit.body: The base unit on the right side of the conversion.
help.master-customFields.title: Custom fields
help.master-customFields.body: Configure up to four text or date fields in Settings. Leave a field name empty to hide it. Print choices are saved for invoice templates.
help.master-taxRate.title: Tax rate (%)
help.master-taxRate.body: Spreadsheet percentage, using an available GST rate. Enter the number without a percent sign.
help.master-unit.title: Unit symbol
help.master-unit.body: Use an existing unit symbol exactly as shown in Items → Units.
help.master-category.title: Category name
help.master-category.body: Use an existing category name. Create missing categories in Items before importing.
help.master-secondaryUnit.title: Secondary unit symbol
help.master-secondaryUnit.body: Use an existing secondary unit symbol and provide its conversion into base units.
help.master-inclusive.title: Sale price includes tax
help.master-inclusive.body: Use true when the entered sale price already includes GST; false when GST is added to it.
help.master-purchaseInclusive.title: Purchase price includes tax
help.master-purchaseInclusive.body: Use true if GST is already included in the purchase price.
help.master-purchaseInclusive.example: On: the supplier’s price includes GST
help.setting-partyStatus.title: Party active / inactive status
help.setting-partyStatus.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
help.setting-itemTax.title: Item-wise tax
help.setting-itemTax.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
help.setting-itemDiscount.title: Item-wise discount
help.setting-itemDiscount.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
help.setting-wholesale.title: Wholesale prices
help.setting-wholesale.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
help.setting-mrp.title: Maximum retail price (MRP)
help.setting-mrp.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
help.setting-qtyDecimals.title: Quantity decimal places
help.setting-qtyDecimals.body: Controls the related fields in party and item forms. Saved values remain available when enabled again.
masters.error.money: Enter an amount in rupees with at most two decimal places.
help.master-discountPercent.title: Sale discount (%)
help.master-discountPercent.body: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, without a percent sign. Use at most two decimal places.
sales.intro: Record documents, review payments, and keep ledgers up to date.
sales.discardDraft: This unsaved bill will be removed from this device. Keep the tab open to save your work for later.
sales.gridHelp: Search by name, code or barcode. Enter moves across a row; Enter on the last editable cell adds a row and opens item search. Ctrl+Del removes the current row.
sales.creditWarning: This bill exceeds the credit limit
sales.creditConfirm: The party will owe more than their credit limit. Save this bill anyway?
sales.stockBlocked: Not enough stock. Reduce the quantity or adjust stock before saving.
sales.stockWarning: This sale will take stock below zero. Please check the quantity.
sales.invalid: Choose a party for credit bills, add items with positive quantities, and check phone, dates, prices and discounts.
sales.emptyBody: Create a document or change the filters to see your bills.
sales.confirm.delete: Move this document to the recycle bin? Its stock, payments and balance effects will be removed. You can restore it later.
sales.confirm.cancel: Cancel this document? Its number stays reserved and its stock, payments and balance effects will be removed.
sales.confirm.close: Close this quotation? It will stay in the list and cannot be converted while closed.
sales.noOpenInvoices: No unpaid invoices. The receipt will stay as an advance in the party account.
sales.receiptInvalid: Choose a party and payment account, enter a positive amount and a valid receipt number.
sales.shareHelp: Sharing saves a PDF and opens its folder. Attach that PDF yourself in WhatsApp or email.
sales.shared: PDF saved. WhatsApp is open — attach the PDF from the folder we just opened.
sales.error.duplicate: This number is already used. Choose another number or prefix.
sales.error.negativeStock: Not enough stock to save this bill. Reduce the quantity or add stock.
sales.error.allocation: Check payment allocations: use open invoices of this party and do not exceed their balance or the receipt amount. A payment discount must be fully allocated.
sales.error.linked: This bill has linked receipts or returns. Cancel or remove those first, then change this bill.
sales.error.overpayment: Payment or return exceeds the bill total. Walk-in bills must be paid in full; use a party account for credit.
sales.tourNewBody: Open another bill anytime. Draft tabs are saved on this device until you save or discard them.
sales.tourWorkBody: Choose the party and supply state, then add items. GST and totals update as you type.
sales.tourActionsBody: Save with Ctrl+S, print a PDF, or record Payment-In against unpaid bills.
print.name: Item
help.sale-saleMode.title: Payment mode
help.sale-saleMode.body: Cash allows an unnamed walk-in customer. For any unpaid balance, choose a party so their account stays correct.
help.sale-saleMode.example: Cash + full payment, or Credit + party
help.sale-party.title: Party
help.sale-party.body: Search by name or phone. Credit bills need a party; cash bills can use a walk-in customer.
help.sale-partyName.title: Customer name (optional)
help.sale-partyName.body: Enter or choose customer name (optional) for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-phone.title: Phone number
help.sale-phone.body: Enter or choose phone number for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-prefix.title: Number prefix
help.sale-prefix.body: Letters shown before the auto number. Different prefixes keep separate sequences.
help.sale-number.title: Document number
help.sale-number.body: A number is unique for this document type and prefix. Cancelled and deleted numbers stay reserved.
help.sale-date.title: Date
help.sale-date.body: Enter or choose date for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-dueDate.title: Due date
help.sale-dueDate.body: Enter or choose due date for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-paymentTerms.title: Payment terms (days)
help.sale-paymentTerms.body: Days allowed for payment. Changing this value calculates a due date from the bill date.
help.sale-placeOfSupply.title: Place of supply
help.sale-placeOfSupply.body: This state decides GST. The same business state uses CGST and SGST; another state uses IGST.
help.sale-billingAddress.title: Billing address
help.sale-billingAddress.body: Enter or choose billing address for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-shippingAddress.title: Shipping address
help.sale-shippingAddress.body: Enter or choose shipping address for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-reference.title: Original invoice reference
help.sale-reference.body: Enter or choose original invoice reference for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-item.title: Item
help.sale-item.body: Enter or choose item for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-qty.title: Qty
help.sale-qty.body: Billed quantity. The wholesale price applies when the base quantity reaches the item threshold.
help.sale-freeQty.title: Free quantity column
help.sale-freeQty.body: Free units reduce stock but do not increase the billed amount.
help.sale-unit.title: Unit
help.sale-unit.body: Choose the base or secondary unit. Secondary quantities are converted using the item conversion.
help.sale-price.title: Price / unit (₹)
help.sale-price.body: Enter or choose price / unit (₹) for this document. Check it before saving; drafts are kept locally until saved or discarded.
help.sale-inclusive.title: Tax mode
help.sale-inclusive.body: Inclusive extracts GST from the entered price. Exclusive adds GST on top of the price.
help.sale-discountPercent.title: Disc %
help.sale-discountPercent.body: Percentage discount on this line before GST. Entering it clears the rupee discount.
help.sale-discount.title: Disc ₹
help.sale-discount.body: Enter a fixed line discount in rupees. Entering it clears the percentage discount.
help.sale-taxRate.title: GST %
